forbidden_before_release: fresh source selection or source-text/token loading
retraining, checkpoint reselection, or broad variants

prior_pr20_overlap.interpretation: TRR-0010/PR20 is selection-overlapping development evidence; preserve its predictions, scores, and receipts, but do not call it an independent text-generalization estimate.

frozen_primary.reporting: report each domain-target cell separately; do not pool domains or targets

common_a1_a2_subset.selection: first 128 records in the frozen confirmation order, fixed before observations/predictions/truth; no truth- or prediction-driven subsampling

prospective_source_extension.source_order: deterministic row order under the registered seed, then first 256 eligible unique records per domain

finance.reason: deliberate new reservation outside the prior selected-panel range; prior-range exhaustion is not assumed

pile.reason: deliberate new reservation outside the prior selected-panel range; prior-range exhaustion is not assumed; capacity must be checked after all exclusions

prospective_source_extension.capacity_rule: If a registered extension cannot yield 256 eligible records after all exclusions, stop and register a compatible extension before selecting replacements; do not recycle prior validation records or silently shrink the primary panel.

identity_fields: legacy H129/truncated sequence fingerprint where that is the published convention
must_include: all TRR-0003 through TRR-0008 identity ledgers and opaque reservations
TRR-0002 configuration-search and calibration identity ledgers
all accessible TRR-P09/TRR-0010 fitting-bank and public-validation ledgers
P03 sealed holdout via root-owned opaque exclusion only
exclusion_protocol.expected_intersections: zero on every available matching field before capture; record unavailable fields explicitly rather than implying zero
exclusion_protocol.opaque_handoff: exchange only canonical public-record and sequence hashes with Agent1; no source labels, predictions, scores, or truth
exclusion_protocol.reused_validation_regression: a synthetic candidate copied from TRR-0009 selection_v2 must be rejected before any observation capture; retain rejection reason and no-payload-open receipt

curator_boundary.trusted_producer: may inspect public source rows only to compute identity metadata and capture target observations
curator_boundary.truth_sidecar: materialize and keep separate; open once only after all registered predictions and diagnostics are frozen

diagnostics: A1 proposal failure: true token absent from top-256 proposal
A1+A2 direct-ranking failure: true token proposed but wrong K256 winner
direct B0/B1 ranking failure where the full-vocabulary rank is available
public fitting support bucket and post-BOS position
postscore_error_inventory.unavailable_diagnostics: report unavailable if the immutable package did not persist the needed candidate or score trace; do not rerun selectively after truth

resource_basis.projected_a1_a2_two_target_subset_second: approximately 450 s for 2 domains x 128 records x 2 targets, excluding setup
resource_basis.release_preflight: qualify the largest A1+A2 cell with a fail-closed guard and safety margin; do not use batching as a semantic workaround without output-equivalence evidence

pending_release_dependencies: Agent1 immutable inference package and replay receipt
root/Agent1 agreement on the exact extension and opaque reservation handoff
exclusion worker count-only audit across all listed ledgers
root authorization to begin source selection, capture, prediction, and truth boundary
